│                           │  r       ⟦Reject a pending item (→ deprecated, asks for a reason)~~~~~~~~~~~~~~… │                           │
│                           │  d       ⟦Remove an item (→ deprecated, a reason is required)~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~… │                           │
│                           │  A       ⟦Approve in bulk (selected items or the whole filtered list); items wi… │                           │
│                           │  R       ⟦Reject in bulk (selected items or the whole filtered list)~~~~~~~~~~~… │                           │
│                           │          ⟦Plan a batch review: which items can be written, which are left out~~… │                           │
│                           │  e       ⟦Edit the item in $EDITOR, then reload~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~⟧                  │                           │
│                           │  n       ⟦Add a knowledge item (form)~~~~~~~~~~~⟧  bint knowledge add            │                           │
